title: Volcano alert level badge
description: A compact badge showing a volcano's alert level and aviation color code together, always as words (NORMAL/GREEN, ADVISORY/YELLOW, WATCH/ORANGE, WARNING/RED), with the volcano name, the time the level took effect and a one-sentence statement.

colorCode.description: Aviation color code. It pairs with the alert level: NORMAL/GREEN, ADVISORY/YELLOW, WATCH/ORANGE, WARNING/RED

examples: Unrest continues; an eruption is possible with little warning.
